|---|---|---|---|---|

In addition, at december 31, 2008, $ 92300 of the future minimum payments in the table above for leases, sponsorship, licensing and other agreements was accrued. Consolidated rental expense for the company 's office space, which is recognized on a straight line basis over the life of the lease, was approximately $ 42905, $ 35614 and $ 31467 for the years ended december 31, 2008, 2007 and 2006, respectively.
